why: Build fix round after the review's first send-back (2026-11-16-effect-e87-review) of judgment slice E87 of the Effect-check sweep (missingPipeableSignature in libfabrika's runtime, cloudflare, processes, settings and ledger folders), in next/. Fixed the two hits the review sent back, by hand with the Edit tool: decodeExitReason (processes/ExitReason.ts:57) and letterBody (processes/Mailbox.ts:122). Each was a Schema decoder exported as is, typed (input: unknown, options?: ParseOptions), and the check fires on that optional second argument. The fix narrows each export to a one-argument function that calls the same decoder, (input: unknown): ReturnType<typeof decode> => decode(input), so the result type (Result for the exit reason, Option for the letter body), the error shape and the onExcessProperty: 'error' option stay the same; ExitReason.ts keeps the decoder in a private const decode. Narrowing is the fix here, not Function.dual: the input is untrusted unknown, so no predicate on the first argument can tell a direct call from a piped one, and a dual could read the options object as the input. No caller changes: every caller passes one argument (ProcessManager.ts:387, cloudflare/runtime.ts:1569, ProgramMailLedger.ts:180), and none passes the decoder as a callback. Left 1: nodeExecution (runtime/Execution.ts:252), untouched, since it waits on an owner or lead call (the review row says why). No lock line, no tsconfig change, no disable or @effect-diagnostics comment, no list entry.
